lessonRef.unitTitle: Taking Care of My Own Space
lessonRef.title: Launch and diagnostic: why our spaces matter

standardsRefs: Manuel Academy Ready for Life elementary sequence — Grade 3
Ready for Life v1 safety, supervision, and no-shame policy reference
Manuel Academy RFL G3 Unit 1 — personal and shared space care
Manuel Academy local Ready for Life composition
objective: I can practice why our spaces matter. I will do one step at a time and check one result.
scenario: Before any cleaning happens, the learner walks through their own space with paper and a pencil, stops at three specific zones in order, and records what they find in each one without straightening anything up yet, since today is only about noticing, not fixing.
materials: learner-local: paper or a notebook to record ratings

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g3-u01-l01-model-card. Watch one complete example.

prompts.text: Name the first move in the model and explain why it comes first.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g3-u01-l01-guided-card. Do the coached move.

prompts.text: Name the move you completed and the success check it meets.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g3-u01-l01-independent-card. Choose one complete route. Follow its steps.

prompts.text: Which complete route did you use?
Record the completed step numbers and one non-sensitive result statement.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g3-u01-l01-evidence-record. Save one result and one reflection.

prompts.text: Describe one specific time in the last week when clutter in one of these three zones actually caused a problem for you or for someone else in your home. What exactly happened?

remediation: Compare the missed move with the worked move on swk-rfl-g3-u01-l01-model-card; name one observable difference and review only the matching instruction step. Complete the affected move on swk-rfl-g3-u01-l01-guided-card with one coach prompt and receive feedback tied to the success check. Name the observable move that now meets the check and the one move, if any, that still needs correction. Do not use shame, trait, effort, or character judgments. Complete the same move on the fresh parallel condition in swk-rfl-g3-u01-l01-retry-pair without the coach prompt. Exit: The supported and parallel moves both meet the named success check: Zone survey accuracy: Names at least three specific items to support the rating for all three zones. | Reasoning about impact: Gives one specific reason for self and one specific, different reason for someone else who shares the home. Resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g3-u01-l01-independent-card. A physical task resumes only with required permission and supervision; otherwise finish the equal-credit fictional route.
extension: Have the learner repeat the same three-zone survey in a shared family space they do not fully control, such as a hallway or a shared bathroom shelf, and compare in writing whether the shared space rated messier than their own personal zones.

resources.title: why our spaces matter worked model
resources.purpose: Shows the starting condition, visible moves, reasoning, and success check before the learner begins.
content: Starting condition: Before any cleaning happens, the learner walks through their own space with paper and a pencil, stops at three specific zones in order, and records what they find in each one without straightening anything up yet, since today is only about noticing, not fixing.
Model move 1: Read the condition and name the exact why our spaces matter decision or action.
Model move 2: Before walking around, make a guess.
Model move 3: Visit the three zones in order.

Model check: Zone survey accuracy: Names at least three specific items to support the rating for all three zones. | Reasoning about impact: Gives one specific reason for self and one specific, different reason for someone else who shares the home.

resources.title: why our spaces matter action steps
resources.purpose: Provides the ordered directions used by the model, guided attempt, independent task, and retry.
content: 1. Read the goal for why our spaces matter.
2. Watch the worked move on swk-rfl-g3-u01-l01-model-card.
3. Do one coached move on swk-rfl-g3-u01-l01-guided-card.
4. Complete the chosen route on swk-rfl-g3-u01-l01-independent-card.

resources.title: why our spaces matter coached first attempt
resources.purpose: Carries the complete first attempt and a fresh correction turn.
content: Fictional practice condition: Before any cleaning happens, the learner walks through their own space with paper and a pencil, stops at three specific zones in order, and records what they find in each one without straightening anything up yet, since today is only about noticing, not fixing.
Coach direction: Before walking around, make a guess.
Learner prompt: Which of your three zones — the floor, a flat surface, or a closed storage spot — do you think will turn out the messiest, and why do you think that?
Feedback check: name the move completed, point to the matching success check, and identify one missing or uncertain step without judging the learner.
Fresh correction turn: use the same fictional condition with one constraint changed; restate the changed constraint, redo only the affected step, and check the new result.

resources.title: why our spaces matter complete application
resources.purpose: Contains the lesson-specific application directions and prompts; it is the delivered card referenced by the learner flow.
content: Application direction: Visit the three zones in order. At each one, name at least three actual items you see before you decide on a rating of clear, partly cluttered, or very cluttered.
Response 1 (t2-p1): I looked at the floor of my space and rated it clear, partly cluttered, or very cluttered, naming at least three items I saw there.
Response 2 (t2-p2): I looked at one flat surface, such as a desk, dresser top, or nightstand, and rated it the same way.
Response 3 (t2-p3): I opened one closed storage spot, such as a drawer, bin, or closet shelf, and rated what I found inside.
Response 4 (t2-p4): I wrote down the specific items that earned each zone its rating, not just the rating word alone.
Equal-access rule: Use the fictional condition above and complete the same reasoning and evidence without private real-world details.

resources.title: why our spaces matter minimal evidence record
resources.purpose: Defines exactly what the learner saves and what must not be collected.
content: Record only: selected route, completed step numbers, one non-sensitive result statement, and one revision if a step changed.
Reflection: Describe one specific time in the last week when clutter in one of these three zones actually caused a problem for you or for someone else in your home. What exactly happened?

Success checks: Zone survey accuracy: Names at least three specific items to support the rating for all three zones. | Reasoning about impact: Gives one specific reason for self and one specific, different reason for someone else who shares the home.
Do not collect: names, signatures, addresses, or exact locations; account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details; photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules.

resources.title: why our spaces matter supported and parallel retry cards
resources.purpose: Delivers a real correction loop rather than a direction to try again without support.
content: Contrast reteach: compare the model check on swk-rfl-g3-u01-l01-model-card with the missed or unsupported step; name the one observable difference.
Supported card: return to swk-rfl-g3-u01-l01-guided-card, complete the affected move with one coach prompt, and receive criterion-specific feedback.
Parallel card: use a fresh fictional why our spaces matter condition with one changed constraint; complete the same move without the coach prompt.

Exit check: the corrected move meets this lesson's checks — Zone survey accuracy: Names at least three specific items to support the rating for all three zones. | Reasoning about impact: Gives one specific reason for self and one specific, different reason for someone else who shares the home..
Return: resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g3-u01-l01-independent-card; a physical route resumes only when the authorized adult says it is safe.

simulationRoute.title: why our spaces matter — complete fictional route
simulationRoute.directions: Complete the why our spaces matter task using the fictional condition and invented, non-sensitive details on the delivered independent card.
simulationRoute.completionCondition: Complete the same decision, procedure, evidence, and revision checks as the real-life route. No adult attests that a physical event occurred.

independentTask.privacyAlternative: The learner may use invented names, dates, amounts, organizations, spaces, and circumstances whenever real details are unnecessary or private.

learnerEvidence: one revision when a step changed
evidence.reflectionPrompt: Describe one specific time in the last week when clutter in one of these three zones actually caused a problem for you or for someone else in your home. What exactly happened?
observableCriteria: Zone survey accuracy: Names at least three specific items to support the rating for all three zones.
Reasoning about impact: Gives one specific reason for self and one specific, different reason for someone else who shares the home.
doNotCollect: names, signatures, addresses, or exact locations
account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details
photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules

retry.trigger: Start the correction loop when a required step is missing, the reason does not match the condition, a safety or privacy boundary is crossed, or the evidence does not show the stated result.
retry.targetedReteach: Compare the missed move with the worked move on swk-rfl-g3-u01-l01-model-card; name one observable difference and review only the matching instruction step.
retry.supportedReattempt: Complete the affected move on swk-rfl-g3-u01-l01-guided-card with one coach prompt and receive feedback tied to the success check.
retry.feedback: Name the observable move that now meets the check and the one move, if any, that still needs correction. Do not use shame, trait, effort, or character judgments.
retry.parallelReattempt: Complete the same move on the fresh parallel condition in swk-rfl-g3-u01-l01-retry-pair without the coach prompt.
retry.exitCriterion: The supported and parallel moves both meet the named success check: Zone survey accuracy: Names at least three specific items to support the rating for all three zones. | Reasoning about impact: Gives one specific reason for self and one specific, different reason for someone else who shares the home.
retry.returnPath: Resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g3-u01-l01-independent-card. A physical task resumes only with required permission and supervision; otherwise finish the equal-credit fictional route.

guardianInvolvement.role: Optional coach only; no guardian attestation is required.
guardianInvolvement.signOffBoundary: A guardian attestation certifies only that the named physical event occurred. It never scores the learner reflection or proves effort, honesty, maturity, responsibility, diagnosis, or character.

safety.stopRule: Stop the physical route when permission, supervision, a safe setting, or an expected material is missing, or when a new hazard appears. Continue only when the authorized adult resolves it; otherwise use the complete fictional route.
safety.physicalBoundary: The learner follows the source safety notes and never performs adult-only handling, transport, account, legal, medical, heat, sharp-tool, electrical, chemical, or machine actions.
safety.noShameRule: Describe only the observable step, condition, evidence, or revision. Never label the learner, household, body, ability, effort, maturity, responsibility, or character.

privacy.rule: Collect the smallest process record that shows the lesson steps. A learner may choose fictional details and may decline private disclosure without losing credit.
doNotCollect: names, signatures, addresses, or exact locations
account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details
photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules

may: coach the guided and retry cards
mayNot: observe or claim a physical condition
tutorBoundary.physicalCompletionRule: Tutor or AI may coach. Tutor or AI may not certify that a real-world physical action occurred.
tutorBoundary.missingResourceAction: Stop and name the unresolved resource. Do not fabricate it; use another complete delivered route only when every resource for that route resolves.
